title: TriggerMlEvent
description: Message published to the trigger.ml Kafka topic by ui-orchestrator, consumed by ml-trainer's `consume` mode. Discriminated by `analysis` — the same business-language value ui-orchestrator received on POST /trigger, never translated into a separate internal vocabulary (see conductor/tracks/exec-trigger_20260807/payloads.md).

runId.description: Same run_id ui-orchestrator returned in the 202 response to POST /trigger.

splitDate.description: Temporal split boundary, YYYY-MM-DD. Always required — no hardcoded default (see docs/insights/temporal-split-data-dependency.md).
